mod.help: Settings for the Journey HUD mod.

target_page.title: Target panel
target_page.help: The health, posture and status buildup of the enemy you are locked on to, and where they sit.

minimap_page.title: Minimap
minimap_page.help: The round minimap: what it shows, how big it is and when it hides.

enabled.label: Target bar
enabled.help: Show the health and posture of the enemy you are locked on to.

numbers.label: Health numbers
numbers.help: Show the health, posture and buildup numbers.

buildup.label: Status buildup
buildup.help: Show the poison, rot, bleed, death blight, frost, sleep and madness buildup of the target.

scale.label: Size
scale.help: Size of the target bar. 1 = normal.

offset_x.label: Right margin
offset_x.help: Distance of the minimap and the target bar from the right edge of the screen.

offset_y.label: Top margin
offset_y.help: Distance of the minimap (or the target bar, without it) from the top edge of the screen.

minimap.label: Minimap
minimap.help: Show a round minimap with the other players, your spirits and the enemy you are locked on to.

minimap_map.label: Map
minimap_map.help: Draw the game's world map under the minimap. Needs the game's map files, which it reads from the game folder.

minimap_graces.label: Graces
minimap_graces.help: Mark the sites of grace you have found on the minimap.

minimap_points.label: Points of interest
minimap_points.help: Mark the ruins, churches, caves, bosses and other places of the world map on the minimap.

minimap_beacons.label: Beacons
minimap_beacons.help: Mark the beacons you have placed on the world map on the minimap.

minimap_goblins.label: Map for Goblins
minimap_goblins.help: Mark the items and places of the Map for Goblins DLL on the minimap, when it is installed.

minimap_coop.label: Co-op players
minimap_coop.help: Mark your co-op partners on the minimap.

minimap_spirits.label: Spirits
minimap_spirits.help: Mark your summoned spirits on the minimap.

minimap_full_map.label: Full map
minimap_full_map.help: Show the whole world map. Off shows only what your map fragments reveal.

minimap_clock.label: Clock
minimap_clock.help: Show the in-game time under the minimap.

minimap_deaths.label: Deaths
minimap_deaths.help: Show your death count above the minimap.

minimap_trail.label: Trail
minimap_trail.help: Draw the path you have walked on the minimap.

minimap_compass.label: Compass
minimap_compass.help: Show N, E, S and W on the rim of the minimap.

minimap_rotate.label: Turn with camera
minimap_rotate.help: Turn the minimap with the camera. Off keeps north at the top.

minimap_hide_caves.label: Hide in caves
minimap_hide_caves.help: Hide the minimap in caves, catacombs and other dungeons.

minimap_hide_boss.label: Hide in boss fights
minimap_hide_boss.help: Hide the minimap while a boss health bar is on screen.

minimap_range.label: Minimap range
minimap_range.help: How far the minimap sees, from its center to its rim, in meters.
